description.fr-FR: Les dix oraisons funèbres de Bossuet dans l’édition Lachat : Henriette-Marie, Henriette-Anne, Marie-Thérèse, Anne de Gonzague, Le Tellier, Condé, ainsi que le P. Bourgoing, Nicolas Cornet, l’abbesse Yolande de Monterby et Henri de Gornay.
description.en-US: All ten of Bossuet’s funeral orations in the Lachat edition: Henrietta Maria, Henrietta Anne, Maria Theresa, Anne de Gonzague, Le Tellier, Condé, and also Father Bourgoing, Nicolas Cornet, Abbess Yolande de Monterby and Henri de Gornay.
description.pt-BR: As dez orações fúnebres de Bossuet na edição Lachat: Henriqueta Maria, Henriqueta Ana, Maria Teresa, Ana de Gonzaga, Le Tellier, Condé, e ainda o pe. Bourgoing, Nicolas Cornet, a abadessa Yolande de Monterby e Henri de Gornay.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of the Lachat edition, volume012/024.htm to 033.htm. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
